name: robustfit_intercept
expr: b = robustfit(x, y); nb = numel(b); b1 = b(1); b2 = b(2); bb = robustfit(X2, y2); nbb = numel(bb); bb1 = bb(1); bb2 = bb(2); bb3 = bb(3); bo = robustfit(x, y, 'bisquare', [], 'off'); nbo = numel(bo);
comment: robustfit default intercept term vs MATLAB R2025b. DEEP-PROBE 2026-05-31 (toolbox pivot, libs/stats): robustfit treated X as the full design matrix and never prepended the constant column, so robustfit(x,y) returned a single through-origin coefficient instead of MATLAB's [intercept; slope]. MATLAB adds the constant by default (const='on'); 'off' suppresses it. Fix prepends a ones column unless const='off'. With the outlier fully downweighted by the bisquare weight the fit is exact: y=2x+1+outlier -> b=[1;2]; y=3+2x+0.5x^2+outlier -> [3;2;0.5]; const 'off' -> 1 coefficient. (Residual leverage-adjustment precision on NOISY data is a separate known gap; tested here only on exact-recovery data.) covers:[robustfit].
